subject: AUTO-EXP-OPP-001

official_product_contract.observed: Desktop scheduled tasks can use local projects and run in the project directory; the computer must be on and the app running when local files are required.

limitations: The first scheduled execution has not occurred, so runtime delivery and notification behavior remain unobserved.
Local execution depends on the machine being on, the desktop app running, and the repository remaining available.
The automation metadata is external control-plane state; the repository records its last verified identity and hash but does not control it.
decision: The heartbeat is registered and its saved prompt plus repository preflight can resume EXP-OPP-001 from durable state without conversation history. Retain active_unobserved runtime status until the first scheduled run succeeds.
